title: Red panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#c8582a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="83" rx="15" ry="10" fill="#e8743c"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="74" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#7a3018" transform="rotate(20 27 74)"/>
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="74" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#7a3018" transform="rotate(-20 73 74)"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="86" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#a8441e" transform="rotate(-20 78 86)"/>
  <ellipse cx="85" cy="88" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#3a1a10" transform="rotate(-20 85 88)"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="8" fill="#7a3018"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="8" fill="#7a3018"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="30" r="4" fill="#e8743c"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="4" fill="#e8743c"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="26" fill="#d2632e"/>
  <!-- face white patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#f7ece0"/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="43" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#7a3018"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="43" rx="8" ry="7" fill="#7a3018"/>
  <!-- eyes sparkly -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="#3a1a10"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="#3a1a10"/>
  <circle cx="40.5" cy="41.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="62.5" cy="41.5" r="1.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="37.8" cy="44.5" r="1" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="59.8" cy="44.5" r="1" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3a1a10"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M44 58 Q50 63 56 58" stroke="#7a3018" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkle stars around -->
  <path d="M20 18 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M80 16 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <path d="M50 12 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z" fill="#c8f0ff"/>
</svg>
